title: Doing What Matters in Times of Stress
summary: An illustrated guide with practical exercises for noticing difficult feelings and reconnecting with the present.
audience_note: General reading. The publisher provides the full guide and accompanying exercises.

title: Making sense of student stress
summary: Reading about coursework, exams, money worries and the changes that come with university life.
audience_note: UK wellbeing information. UK service instructions do not describe Kenyan services.

title: Making room for rest
summary: Explore sleep habits and routines in the publisher's guide to falling asleep and sleeping better.
audience_note: UK wellbeing information. For local care, speak with your own university or healthcare provider.

title: When university feels lonely
summary: Reading about loneliness, life changes and ways of finding connection with other people.
audience_note: UK wellbeing information. Local organisations and services will differ.

title: Finding human support on campus
summary: The university's own information about its guidance, counselling and student support services.
audience_note: For University of Nairobi students; eligibility and availability are set by that university. Elsewhere, contact your own student affairs office.

title: Mental wellness at Strathmore
summary: The university medical centre's information about its mental wellness and counselling services.
audience_note: Check directly with the centre about appointments, fees and access to services.

title: Daystar Compassion and Care Centre
summary: Student counselling, psychosocial support and community programmes described by Daystar's own care centre.
audience_note: University services and eligibility depend on your campus. Ask the centre about current arrangements.

title: Find your fit with Kindred Collective
summary: Explore the practice's therapy approaches, therapist matching and session information at its own website.
audience_note: Independent therapy practice. Confirm therapist credentials, fees and availability directly before booking.

title: A listening ear in Kenya
summary: Information from Befrienders Kenya about its emotional-support services and how to reach its team.
audience_note: The organisation's verified support page opens on Facebook. Check its current service availability directly.

title: Counselling and wellbeing at USIU-Africa
summary: The university's counselling centre introduces support for academic, social and personal challenges.
audience_note: University service; check eligibility and appointment arrangements with USIU-Africa.

title: Student support at Mount Kenya University
summary: Read about the university's counselling services and the support available to students and staff.
audience_note: University service; confirm current access and appointments with the counselling centre.

title: Come back to your senses
summary: A guide to grounding, including a five-senses activity you can practise at your own pace.
audience_note: General wellbeing reading from Scotland. Local healthcare arrangements differ in Kenya.

title: Make room for a calmer breath
summary: The publisher's gentle breathing guidance, including finding a comfortable position and an unforced rhythm.
audience_note: Practise comfortably. You can return to natural breathing or stop if an exercise feels uncomfortable.

title: Understanding student counselling
summary: An NHS overview of student counselling, university support services and ways to seek help with low mood, study stress or relationship difficulties.
audience_note: UK information. Service eligibility and funding arrangements differ in Kenya. Ask your own university about local support. Publisher review listed: March 2023.

title: A place to talk at UoN
summary: The university introduces its Wellness Centre and the kinds of concerns students can bring, including study pressure, relationships and emotional difficulties.
audience_note: Campus service information. Confirm current availability and appointments with UoN; ENWEN does not make bookings.

title: Finding support together on campus
summary: A Strathmore Mental Health Club event page describes peer dialogue, creative expression and connecting students with support.
audience_note: Past event dated 10 September 2026. Read for campus community context; it is not a current event invitation or counselling appointment.

title: Support through the university years
summary: USIU-Africa outlines counselling, wellness activities and ways to approach its centre for personal, academic, social or emotional concerns.
audience_note: Campus service information. Confirm eligibility, current hours and appointment arrangements with USIU-Africa.

title: Someone to talk to at KCA
summary: KCA describes individual and group counselling, personal development, peer-counsellor training and referrals for students.
audience_note: For KCA students. Use the university’s current booking information and confirm availability directly.

title: Finding your support network at KU
summary: KU Student Affairs describes its student welfare work, including health and wellness coordination, disability support, accommodation and bursary services.
audience_note: Student welfare directory, not a therapy guide. Ask KU which office or service fits your circumstances.

title: A listening place at JKUAT
summary: JKUAT’s Dean of Students introduces its student welfare role and counselling support, with attention to students’ emotional and social wellbeing.
audience_note: For JKUAT campus support. Check current counselling access and locations directly with the Dean of Students office.

title: Finding your people at Tangaza
summary: Tangaza’s student association describes student welfare representation, clubs, peer counselling and creative or wellness-oriented groups.
audience_note: Student association information, not a clinical service. Ask Tangaza about current groups and appropriate professional support when needed.
